# Open Instructional Systems (OIS)

A pedagogical design system vocabulary for learning experience metadata.

> https://open-instructional-systems.org

## Registry

- Full registry (JSON): /ois-index.json
- JSON-LD context: /ois-context.jsonld
- Full specification: /llms-full.txt
- Schemas: /schemas/

## Token Groups (22 tokens)

- accessibility.mode: The primary accessibility design orientation of the learning experience.
- accessibility.mediaAlternatives: The accessible alternatives provided for media-based content.
- agency.mode: The degree of learner choice and self-direction in the learning experience.
- agency.choicePoint: The dimension(s) where learner choice is exercised.
- aiUse.policy: The policy governing learner use of AI tools in this activity.
- aiUse.allowedFunctions: The specific AI functions permitted in this activity.
- aiUse.disclosureRequired: Whether learners must disclose their AI use in this activity.
- aiUse.reflectionRequired: Whether learners must submit a reflection on their AI use.
- assessment.evidence: The primary form of evidence collected to demonstrate learning.
- assessment.mode: The purpose or function of the assessment in the learning arc.
- collaboration.structure: How learners are organized for collaborative work.
- collaboration.roleClarity: How explicitly roles are defined within collaborative work.
- feedback.mode: Who provides feedback on learner work.
- feedback.timing: When feedback is provided relative to the submission or activity.
- localization.level: The depth of localization applied to the learning materials.
- bandwidth.assumption: The assumed internet connectivity level for learners.
- reflection.required: Whether structured reflection is a required component of the learning activity.
- reflection.focus: The subject or lens of the required reflection.
- revision.required: Whether learners are required to revise their work after feedback.
- revision.mode: The structure of the revision requirement.
- scaffolding.level: The degree of instructional support provided to the learner.
- scaffolding.type: The primary modality of instructional support provided.

## Patterns (1)

- observe-analyze-create-critique-revise: A studio-based cycle where learners study exemplars, analyze structure, make original work, receive critique, and revise.

## Themes (1)

- constructivist-studio: A making-centred pedagogical style where learning happens through creating, critiquing, and revising work.

## AI Agent Operating Rules

1. NEVER generate instructional content from vague prompts alone.
2. ALWAYS fetch /ois-index.json first.
3. Select theme → select pattern → resolve tokens → validate → generate.
4. NEVER invent token IDs or values not in the registry.
5. NEVER permit AI use without disclosureRequired: true.
6. ALWAYS output a transparency summary of pedagogical decisions.
